topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I walked through the hum of the office, the familiar drone not quite matching the silence that had settled in my thoughts. The papers on his desk, the way he spoke of board meetings and tight deadlines—it was a script he knew by heart. But the walls of the company he swore he worked for didn’t exist beyond the confines of his carefully crafted story. It’s funny, the things we hide behind, the roles we play. I suppose I’ll ask him about it soon, maybe over coffee. There’s a gentle rain starting outside, a soft curtain drawing over the day. It’s a good day for conversations that need a little more space.
